directorStatement.audienceFeeling: The audience is pulled into a bee-height pollen chase that can barely contain Fuzzby’s self-mythologising speed, then feels the same playful corridor inhale when thunder turns his performance into exposed nerves.
directorStatement.emotionalChange: Fuzzby’s want governs the scene: he wants to look like a brilliant professional while his body keeps providing evidence against him. Zenny remains the stabilising witness, not a co-chaos participant. The emotional point is not that Fuzzby fails; it is that he instantly edits failure into triumph because being visibly wrong feels too small to bear.
directorStatement.theLaugh: Primary comic mechanism: escalating overcommitment. Fuzzby’s first over-fast pollen scoop becomes the FWIP crash, the accidental pollen moustache becomes self-appointed status, the attempt to fix the status mark widens it, and the storm-pressure boast sends him straight into a flower. The thunder turn uses anticipation-to-reversal: a sound big enough to change the scene meets Fuzzby’s tiny attempt to claim it as part of his act.
directorStatement.visualSurprise: A bee-height moving corridor of tall warm flowers: Fuzzby and Zenny at the same depth, small and readable, with open space ahead. Zenny glides in a clean line; Fuzzby wobbles into the corridor already mid-zig-zag, humming “BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY, BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY…” as loose golden pollen trails behind him. -> After the storm warning and his brave little pressure boast, Fuzzby is stuck in a flower again, pollen trembling around him as the warm field has begun to feel less safe. Zenny’s quiet sighing presence nearby tells us this is funny — but the sky has changed the room.
directorStatement.carryForward: The field remains funny but no longer fully safe: Fuzzby is stuck again, Zenny has named the storm, and the weather pressure is now active.

creativeIntent.selectedTreatment: Treatment 1 — The Chase That Cannot Quite Keep Up, strengthened with Treatment 3’s field-as-comic-co-performer
creativeIntent.governingAudienceExperience: The audience is pulled into a bee-height pollen chase that can barely contain Fuzzby’s self-mythologising speed, then feels the same playful corridor inhale when thunder turns his performance into exposed nerves.
creativeIntent.scenePurpose: Open the episode in pure bee-scale play, making Fuzzby’s proud overcommitment and Zenny’s calm witnessing instantly legible before thunder reinterprets the same motion as exposed nerves.
creativeIntent.emotionalPointOfView: Fuzzby’s want governs the scene: he wants to look like a brilliant professional while his body keeps providing evidence against him. Zenny remains the stabilising witness, not a co-chaos participant. The emotional point is not that Fuzzby fails; it is that he instantly edits failure into triumph because being visibly wrong feels too small to bear.
creativeIntent.comicOrDramaticMechanism: Primary comic mechanism: escalating overcommitment. Fuzzby’s first over-fast pollen scoop becomes the FWIP crash, the accidental pollen moustache becomes self-appointed status, the attempt to fix the status mark widens it, and the storm-pressure boast sends him straight into a flower. The thunder turn uses anticipation-to-reversal: a sound big enough to change the scene meets Fuzzby’s tiny attempt to claim it as part of his act.
creativeIntent.characterPerformanceStrategy: Fuzzby is always in committed travel: chest leading, wings working too hard, altitude porpoising, every correction overcorrected. His pride is physical before verbal — he straightens after the FWIP as if the leaf were part of the plan. The line “Nailed it.” lands because his body is still recovering. Zenny’s performance is economical: calm pollen work, a precise glide beside him, withheld amusement, then genuine sky-attention at the thunder. Same thunder, different bodies: Fuzzby wobbles and annexes it into performance; Zenny becomes more still and smaller in delivery.
creativeIntent.visualGrammar: Forgiving chase grammar: the camera travels behind and beside the bees through a playable flower corridor, not face-to-face and not locked to safe observation. The opening frame already contains motion: Fuzzby, about 14 inches, and Zenny, about 12 inches, share the same camera depth with open corridor space ahead; Fuzzby’s path is jagged within that corridor while Zenny’s path is a clean thread. Golden loose pollen hangs in the air as visible evidence of movement; no sacks, baskets or loads.
creativeIntent.cameraCharacterRelationship: The camera follows Fuzzby slightly late, with enough softness in the chase that children never lose geography. It does not protect him from leaving the frame edge for a breath, because his character exceeds containment. When Zenny matters, the camera abandons Fuzzby’s noise just long enough for her stillness to become the joke or the warning. No permanent screen sides: geography is held by depth, scale, and relative motion, not assigned lanes.
creativeIntent.movementVersusStillness: Movement is Fuzzby’s mask; stillness is Zenny’s judgement and care. In the comedy unit, Fuzzby’s frantic diagonals repeatedly cross the calm line of Zenny’s work. In the storm unit, the contrast flips in meaning: his movement becomes denial, her stillness becomes alertness. The scene’s shape is therefore not “busy then quiet,” but “movement reinterpreted by weather.”
creativeIntent.depthAndEnvironment: Depth is a corridor of tall flowers, soft necks and high petals that make the bees feel tiny and the field feel playful rather than dangerous. Foreground stems occasionally wipe the frame as the camera chases, while background flowers sway gently until the thunder subtly tightens the space. Leaves are not props waiting for impact; they are springy participants that prove weight through bend, recoil and pollen burst.
creativeIntent.rhythmAndEscalation: The first three beats play as one 28–30 second comedy climb if performance supports it: Stage 1, busy pollen collection and first FWIP; Stage 2, moustache status and Zenny’s dry puncture; Stage 3, fixing makes it worse and triggers the chain-reaction tumble. The storm turn compresses to roughly 12–15 seconds: thunder interrupts, Fuzzby rebrands it, Zenny names the weather, Fuzzby boasts under pressure and is instantly contradicted by the flower. No padding between causes; each new action worsens or redefines the last.
creativeIntent.cutPhilosophy: Cuts are motivated by changed point of view or comic punctuation only. The comedy unit can live in no more than three motivated views: chase-with-Fuzzby, Zenny-as-fixed-witness, and the environment participating in the tumble. The storm unit cuts only when the scene’s knowledge changes: sky sound, Zenny’s warning, Fuzzby’s pressure boast contradicted by impact. No automatic action/consequence/reaction pattern; reactions are held only when they are the joke or the warning.
creativeIntent.openingImage: A bee-height moving corridor of tall warm flowers: Fuzzby and Zenny at the same depth, small and readable, with open space ahead. Zenny glides in a clean line; Fuzzby wobbles into the corridor already mid-zig-zag, humming “BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY, BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY…” as loose golden pollen trails behind him.
creativeIntent.closingImage: After the storm warning and his brave little pressure boast, Fuzzby is stuck in a flower again, pollen trembling around him as the warm field has begun to feel less safe. Zenny’s quiet sighing presence nearby tells us this is funny — but the sky has changed the room.
creativeIntent.handoverToNextScene: The field remains funny but no longer fully safe: Fuzzby is stuck again, Zenny has named the storm, and the weather pressure is now active.
creativeIntent.intendedFinalFeeling: Warm, buoyant belonging with a visible trace of cost — the storm has passed and everyone laughs, but Keen’s boat is gone, Mum had to let him go, and the wristbands carry both loss and home.

emotion.entryState: Charged with self-important speed, already mid-zig-zag and wanting his work to read as brilliant.
emotion.pressure: He is sharing the corridor with Zenny’s visible competence, so every messy correction exposes him by comparison.
emotion.choiceOrRealisation: He chooses to reframe the leaf collision as planned success rather than let the crash sit as a crash.
emotion.exitState: Proud but physically betrayed: upright, chest-forward, still recovering from impact.
emotion.observableEvidence: His path jaggedly porpoises through pollen while Zenny’s path stays clean; after the FWIP his body has not fully settled before he declares victory.
emotion.heldAfterBeat: The audience now knows Fuzzby’s pride will keep outrunning his control.

comedy.setup: A tiny pollen-working corridor where Zenny’s neat efficiency and Fuzzby’s chaotic speed are both readable at the same depth.
comedy.expectation: Fuzzby’s loud rhythm promises busy competence and clean pollen collection.
comedy.disruption: He overdoes the scoop, spins sideways into the leaf, and the leaf FWIPs him back into the air.
comedy.button: Fuzzby’s recovery line lands while his body is still proving the opposite.
comedy.hold: Hold just long enough on the proud recovery for the audience to read leaf recoil, drifting pollen, and Zenny’s unruffled contrast before the next status gag begins.

physicalStaging.staysVisible: Fuzzby, the flower mouth he dives into, the springy leaf, the pollen trail, and Zenny’s steady working line remain readable through the continuous chase geography.
physicalStaging.contactAndWeight: Fuzzby’s sideways momentum visibly depresses the leaf; the leaf bends under him, stores the force, then snaps him back with pollen bursting from the contact.
physicalStaging.payoffShape: A jagged dive becomes a sideways smear, then a clean elastic FWIP back to an over-proud upright hover that cannot hide its wobble.
prohibitedStaging: Do not make the leaf a flat trampoline with no bend or weight.
Do not cut away before the body-to-leaf cause is readable.
Do not park both bees in a neat tracking master that removes Fuzzby’s containment problem.

emotion.entryState: Puffed up from the first rebrand, looking for confirmation that the pollen accident can become status.
emotion.pressure: Zenny’s calm attention is the witness he wants to impress and the witness least likely to be fooled.
emotion.choiceOrRealisation: He chooses to invite admiration instead of noticing that the moustache is evidence of the crash.
emotion.exitState: Momentarily re-labelled: still proud, but now aware enough of Zenny’s tease to react into the next fix.
emotion.observableEvidence: He presents himself chest-forward and asks for the verdict; Zenny’s restraint and dry answer puncture the pose without escalating her body.
emotion.heldAfterBeat: The pollen moustache remains visible as both Fuzzby’s invented badge and Zenny’s proof.

comedy.setup: Fuzzby accidentally wears a pollen moustache after a crash he has already claimed as success.
comedy.expectation: He expects Zenny to validate the moustache as impressive or official.
comedy.disruption: Zenny agrees only far enough to turn “official” into the insult-tag of the joke.
comedy.hold: Hold on Zenny’s economy and Fuzzby’s proud pose absorbing the re-title before he tries to correct the evidence.

emotion.entryState: Embarrassed enough to fix the moustache, but still too proud to fix it gently.
emotion.pressure: Zenny has named the joke, and the pollen mark is visible proof that his official pose was invented.
emotion.choiceOrRealisation: He chooses force over acceptance, trying to wipe away the evidence while still moving like a performer.
emotion.exitState: More exposed than before: messier, tumbled, and surrounded by environmental evidence of his overcommitment.
emotion.observableEvidence: The wipe spreads the pollen; each recovery sends him into another flower-field contact; the final crash makes the failure audible and visible.
emotion.heldAfterBeat: The field is now charged with loose pollen and comic instability, ready for the tonal interruption.

comedy.mechanism: Escalating overcommitment with concealment becoming revelation.
comedy.setup: The pollen moustache is visible and has just been turned into a joke by Zenny.
comedy.expectation: A quick wipe should remove the embarrassing mark and restore Fuzzby’s status.
comedy.disruption: The wipe smears it wider, and the recovery effort throws him into a larger chain of flower and leaf reactions.
comedy.hold: Hold the final tumble shape long enough for the audience to track cause from wipe to smear to field reaction, then let the pollen hang before thunder changes the air.

physicalStaging.staysVisible: Fuzzby’s face-mark, his wiping paw, the nearest flower contacts, responsive leaves, drifting pollen, and Zenny’s calm witnessing position stay geographically clear inside the corridor.
physicalStaging.contactAndWeight: Each contact must prove force: petals compress around him, stems bow under passing impact, leaves recoil after taking his weight, and pollen blooms from every collision point.
physicalStaging.payoffShape: A tiny grooming correction expands into a pinball-like tumble that ends with Fuzzby visibly more marked than when he began.
prohibitedStaging: Do not make the chain reaction a random obstacle course unrelated to the moustache fix.
Do not obscure the widening smear before the tumble begins.
Do not multiply impacts so fast that children lose the cause-and-effect path.

emotion.entryState: Calm, precise, and amused enough to witness Fuzzby without joining the chaos.
emotion.pressure: The thunder introduces a real external change that requires attention rather than teasing.
emotion.choiceOrRealisation: She stops being merely the deadpan witness and becomes the careful one who names what is coming.
emotion.observableEvidence: Her body quiets further at the rumble, her attention goes skyward before she speaks, and her line stays economical rather than alarmed.
emotion.heldAfterBeat: The storm warning remains in the air, making the playful corridor feel tighter.

comedy.setup: The comedy has trained us that Fuzzby turns every mishap into performance material.
comedy.expectation: A thunder rumble should stop the game and make everyone attend to the sky.
comedy.disruption: Fuzzby tries to annex the rumble as dramatic punctuation, while Zenny’s stillness shows it is not part of his act.
comedy.hold: Hold the contrast between Fuzzby’s wobbling rebrand and Zenny’s quiet sky-attention so the laugh thins into warning.

emotion.entryState: Put under real pressure by Zenny’s storm warning and unwilling to let the warning make him look small.
emotion.pressure: The weather has shifted from playful background to approaching storm, and Zenny has named it plainly.
emotion.choiceOrRealisation: He chooses bravado as an answer to pressure instead of adjusting his flight.
emotion.exitState: Physically stuck, comically exposed, and still lovable inside the failure.
emotion.observableEvidence: The line is followed by immediate overcommitted flight into a flower; pollen trembles around him while Zenny remains close enough to sigh the relationship back into warmth.
emotion.heldAfterBeat: The joke remains, but the field now carries storm unease.

comedy.mechanism: Anticipation to reversal, powered by hiding failure.
comedy.setup: Zenny has just named the storm, giving Fuzzby a real pressure cue.
comedy.expectation: Fuzzby’s boast promises competence under pressure and a clean demonstration of control.
comedy.disruption: His demonstration sends him straight into a flower and gets him stuck again.
comedy.button: The flower-held closing image is the punchline: the pressure expert cannot move.
comedy.hold: Hold long enough for pollen trembling, Fuzzby’s stuck shape, and Zenny’s quiet sighing presence to share the frame with the changed sky-feel.

physicalStaging.staysVisible: Fuzzby’s proud launch path, the receiving flower, pollen trembling at impact, and Zenny nearby as quiet witness remain readable; the flower field’s tightened atmosphere must stay present.

shots.principalPerformanceApproved: Fuzzby’s committed travel never relaxes: he hums “BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY, BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY…”, crashes, straightens too proudly for “Nailed it.”, upgrades the moustache with “Do I look official?”, panics into a wipe, then turns the tumble into “Buzz Crash!!”. Zenny stays economical: precise work, watched stillness, a nearly withheld laugh, “Yes Fuzzby Officially nuts!”, then an eye-roll that becomes a smile.
shots.physicalPerformanceApproved: Fuzzby enters already overcommitted: chest leading, wings working too hard, altitude bobbing unevenly through the flower corridor. Each correction throws him into a bigger correction: leaf recoil, face-first pollen reveal, frantic wipe, branch clip, tumble, upside-down blossom catch, then a messier pop-out. Zenny stays close but economical, letting a withheld laugh become an amused eye-roll and small smile.
shots.animationTimingApproved: Keep Fuzzby fast and elastic but readable: sharp launches, squashy flower contact, springy recoil, then brief proud holds that still wobble. Let Zenny’s stillness last longer than Fuzzby expects; her tiny reaction beats must feel deliberately rationed. Pollen hangs after impacts long enough to prove cause and scale.

performanceContractApproved.playableIntention: Fuzzby is trying to make every visible mistake read like impressive competence in front of Zenny; Zenny is letting the truth be seen without abandoning him.

phases.observableAction: He cuts into the corridor already mid-zig-zag, chest forward, wings overworking, rising too high then dipping too low as his paws rake through loose pollen.

He drives too hard into flower after flower, rebounds from a springy leaf, presents the pollen mark on his face, scrubs it wider, clips a branch, tumbles through soft plant contacts, and pops out more coated than before.
She glides beside the chaos on a clean path, holds her body quiet at the face reveal, lets the smallest amusement reach her eyes, then finishes with a restrained eye-roll that softens into a smile.
Leaves sway back from impact, petals relax after holding Fuzzby, and loose golden pollen remains suspended between the bees as the corridor settles from the chain reaction.

performanceContractApproved.physicalCauseAndEffect: Fuzzby’s excess speed pushes him beyond each intended stop; plant surfaces receive that force, bend or compress, then return energy into his body, sending him into the next contact. His paw wipe spreads pollen instead of removing it, so the attempt to hide the evidence creates the larger visible mess.
performanceContractApproved.visibleEmotionalTurn: Fuzzby shifts from busy worker to exposed performer as each proud recovery is contradicted by pollen, wobble, and plant recoil; Zenny shifts from calm comparator to affectionate witness whose restraint becomes part of the joke.
performanceContractApproved.requiredLanding: The final readable image is Fuzzby re-emerging more pollen-covered than before in a cloud of hanging gold dust, with Zenny nearby in amused, contained stillness and the flower corridor still moving from his impacts.
performanceContractApproved.performanceFreedom: Keep the exact wing cadence, rebound arcs, facial micro-reactions, and pollen drift playable, as long as Fuzzby never becomes controlled or level and Zenny never joins the chaos. Impact spacing may breathe for clarity, but each contact must visibly cause the next result.

inputs.title: The Adventure Begins
inputs.logline: When eager young Keen sails away from home and into a storm, he discovers that courage is not looking fearless — it is hearing someone else need him, feeling the gulp, and going anyway.

orderedEvents.text: Tall flowers sway gently in the warm breeze. Some stretch high above the grass, with long soft necks and bright open petals full of pollen. FUZZBY and ZENNY weave between them collecting pollen from flower to flower. Fine golden pollen dusts their paws and trails softly through the air. Zenny works with smooth calm precision — neat, efficient, graceful. Fuzzby does not. He zig-zags wildly through the air, humming loudly to himself as he works.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY, BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY…
He dips low into a flower, scoops up pollen — then overdoes it and spins sideways into a leaf. FWIP. He bounces back into the air and straightens up proudly.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: Nailed it.
Zenny glides up beside him. Watches him for a beat.

beats.storyBeat: The episode opens at bee scale in a bright flower field: Zenny’s graceful competence and Fuzzby’s chaotic overconfidence are instantly legible. Fuzzby’s first pollen dive becomes a crash he rebrands as mastery, planting the whole episode’s comic idea that bravado is not the same as courage.
beats.want: Fuzzby wants to collect pollen like an impressive professional and be seen doing it.
beats.need: He needs to know he belongs even when his body betrays his grand self-image.
beats.kidRead: Funny bee zooms too fast, hits a leaf, bounces back and pretends he meant it.
beats.adultRead: A tiny performer is already covering embarrassment with status — lovable because the mask is transparent.
beats.emotionalIntent: Start with easy laughter, high energy and immediate character contrast, with no danger yet beyond Fuzzby’s own momentum.

beats.storyBeat: The glow settles, Fuzzby claps too early and covers it, and the group swamps Keen in a hug. Aida echoes Mum’s promise in found-family form, and Keen’s full smile lands because he is no longer lost and no longer alone.
beats.want: The group wants to celebrate and claim Keen as one of them.
beats.need: Keen needs to let himself be embraced rather than staying the lone brave sailor.
beats.kidRead: Everyone hugs Keen and he smiles like he is home.
beats.adultRead: Mum’s goodbye line returns from a new mouth, proving that letting go did not leave him unheld.
beats.emotionalIntent: Land the belonging payoff with laughter inside the hug and a homecoming smile as the emotional seal.

cuts.action: His wristbands glow brighter. The energy settles warmly around him. Fuzzby claps too early. Stops. Then starts clapping again louder to cover it. Howey cheers. Misty beams. Luna smiles softly. And suddenly the whole group surges in and SWAMPS Keen in a giant bear hug. Keen startles. Then melts into it. He hugs them back. The group slowly breaks apart. Keen looks around at all of them. No longer lost. No longer alone.

orderedEvents.text: The mood has lifted. Waves lap gently at the shore. Keen and the bears walk together along the sand. Fuzzby buzzes up beside Keen, suddenly very serious.

orderedEvents.text: So… quick question.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Yeah?

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: How do you feel about honey?
Keen looks at him, still catching his breath from everything.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Uh… I like it?

beats.storyBeat: Golden-hour calm replaces storm pressure as Keen walks with the bears. Fuzzby approaches with grave seriousness, treating honey compatibility as the most important next step in friendship.
beats.want: Fuzzby wants to assess whether Keen can join his personal honey-centered universe.
beats.need: Keen needs ordinary silliness after extraordinary events.
beats.kidRead: Fuzzby asks a very serious question about honey.
beats.adultRead: After survival and ceremony, friendship becomes beautifully mundane — the everyday is the proof of safety.
beats.emotionalIntent: Open the ripple with relaxed warmth and a comic handoff from epic to domestic.

beats.want: Fuzzby wants to convert Keen’s honey preference into instant lifelong best-friend status.
beats.need: He needs to pace affection so Keen can actually receive it.
beats.kidRead: Fuzzby gets wildly excited because Keen likes honey.
beats.adultRead: A new friendship is being claimed with comic excess; the love is real, the dosage is absurd.
beats.emotionalIntent: Let the final laugh bloom from Fuzzby’s sincere overcommitment.

beats.need: She needs to show care through control, not confession.

beats.adultRead: The straight-bee is managing everyone’s nervous system with one small tug and one dry line.

beats.storyBeat: Keen and the others laugh as they continue down the beach, and the camera lingers on the bright, peaceful cove. The final image is warmer than the start but still carries the day’s trace: a storm washed clean, a boat gone, wristbands glowing, and a new family walking forward.
beats.want: The group wants to keep moving together into ordinary life.
beats.need: Keen needs belonging to feel light enough to laugh in, not only sacred or heroic.
beats.kidRead: Everyone laughs and walks together by the peaceful water.
beats.adultRead: The ache has not been erased; it has been given company, sunlight and a path forward.
beats.emotionalIntent: End with buoyant peace and a visible aftertaste of cost — the laugh and the lump together.

sourceStoryboard.humanNote: Approved under Julian explicit Stage brief: exact active script, 29s comedy plus 14s storm, <=3 stages/views, loose pollen only, forgiving same-depth chase opener.

inputs.ambitionBrief: Preserve the exact approved script. Package beats 1.B1 through 1.B3 as one natural comedy unit of roughly 28 to 30 seconds only if the performance needs it, with no more than three causal stages and three motivated views. Package beats 1.B4 through 1.B5 as a shorter storm-turn unit of roughly 12 to 15 seconds, also without padding. The active script uses loose golden pollen dust; no body-mounted sacks, bags, baskets or dangling loads. The opening frame must be forgiving chase staging rather than a face-to-face portrait: Fuzzby 14 inches and Zenny 12 inches at the same camera depth, with playable corridor space ahead.

revisionNote: Scene 1 S1.SH1 split into S1.SH1A/S1.SH1B/S1.SH1C protected Seedance 2.5 units with held handoff frames; old 29-second candidates archived as superseded evidence.

handover.rule: S1.SH1 was intentionally split after render review; split units restart as designed and must be generated/approved independently.

supersededShotSplits.reason: Split the crowded 29-second physical comedy unit into protected Seedance units after render review showed compression, missing chase energy and rushed flower/moustache/crash beats.

sourceShot.purpose: Deliver the full comedy climb promised by the treatment: busy competence contrasted with chaotic overcommitment, then status inflation, then a chain-reaction confession of failure.
sourceShot.performanceAssignment: Performance phases: anticipation: Fuzzby He cuts into the corridor already mid-zig-zag, chest forward, wings overworking, rising too high then dipping too low as his paws rake through loose pollen; action: Fuzzby He drives too hard into flower after flower, rebounds from a springy leaf, presents the pollen mark on his face, scrubs it wider, clips a branch, tumbles through soft plant contacts, and pops out more coated than before; reaction: Zenny She glides beside the chaos on a clean path, holds her body quiet at the face reveal, lets the smallest amusement reach her eyes, then finishes with a restrained eye-roll that softens into a smile; settle: ENVIRONMENT Leaves sway back from impact, petals relax after holding Fuzzby, and loose golden pollen remains suspended between the bees as the corridor settles from the chain reaction. Cause and effect: Fuzzby’s excess speed pushes him beyond each intended stop; plant surfaces receive that force, bend or compress, then return energy into his body, sending him into the next contact. His paw wipe spreads pollen instead of removing it, so the attempt to hide the evidence creates the larger visible mess. Visible turn: Fuzzby shifts from busy worker to exposed performer as each proud recovery is contradicted by pollen, wobble, and plant recoil; Zenny shifts from calm comparator to affectionate witness whose restraint becomes part of the joke. Land on: The final readable image is Fuzzby re-emerging more pollen-covered than before in a cloud of hanging gold dust, with Zenny nearby in amused, contained stillness and the flower corridor still moving from his impacts. Acting freedom: Keep the exact wing cadence, rebound arcs, facial micro-reactions, and pollen drift playable, as long as Fuzzby never becomes controlled or level and Zenny never joins the chaos. Impact spacing may breathe for clarity, but each contact must visibly cause the next result.
sourceShot.camera: Create a bee-height CGI chase through tall warm flowers: Fuzzby zig-zags too fast through loose golden pollen while Zenny glides steadily nearby; show the leaf FWIP, pollen moustache status gag, smeared-face tumble and final messier pop-out

sourceShot.cutInMotivation: Remaining continuous would weaken the thunder turn because the comedy unit has already completed its three-stage escalation and needs the next request to begin with the air itself changing; SH1’s natural 29 seconds plus the storm unit’s natural 14 seconds would exceed Seedance’s 30-second continuity capacity.

sourceShot.visualPayoff: Fuzzby reappears from a flower more pollen-covered than before, suspended in a cloud of unsettled golden dust, with Zenny nearby in a small smiling eye-roll as the corridor still sways from the impacts.

storyboardStagePlanApproved.purpose: Introduce the scene as a moving pollen problem: Fuzzby wants his speed to read as expert work, while Zenny’s calm line quietly exposes the difference.
storyboardStagePlanApproved.primaryEvent: Fuzzby barrels through the flower corridor humming “BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY, BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY…”, dives too hard into a flower, scoops pollen, spins sideways into a springy leaf, then is FWIPped back upright by the leaf’s recoil.
storyboardStagePlanApproved.emotionalOrComicTurn: The crash becomes funny because Fuzzby immediately chooses pride over acknowledgement; “Nailed it.” lands while his body is still wobbling from the evidence against him.
storyboardStagePlanApproved.cameraAndTransition: Begin in a forgiving bee-height chase that follows slightly late, letting stems briefly wipe Fuzzby without losing the corridor, then let the camera settle just enough for the leaf’s bend and recoil to be readable.
storyboardStagePlanApproved.observableEndState: Fuzzby hovers upright and chest-forward with pollen drifting around him, still physically unsettled, as Zenny glides close enough to watch.

storyboardStagePlanApproved.purpose: Turn the accidental mess into status play and let Zenny’s restraint define the relationship.

storyboardStagePlanApproved.emotionalOrComicTurn: Zenny nearly laughs but keeps her body economical, then converts his invented rank into an affectionate puncture with “Yes Fuzzby Officially nuts!”
storyboardStagePlanApproved.cameraAndTransition: Cut inside the unit to discover Zenny as the fixed witness beside his moving self-display, holding enough stillness for her dry answer to become the punchline.
storyboardStagePlanApproved.observableEndState: Fuzzby’s pollen moustache remains fully visible as an invented badge and a visible joke, with Zenny close by and amused despite herself.

storyboardStagePlanApproved.emotionalOrComicTurn: The attempted fix becomes the larger reveal; Zenny rolls her eyes but smiles, proving she sees the whole ridiculous truth and stays with him in it.

storyboardStagePlanApproved.observableEndState: Fuzzby pops back out of the last flower more pollen-covered than before, with unsettled golden dust hanging between him and Zenny’s smiling eye-roll.
